static_traits.name: Li Ming
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents, close relationship with Mother
static_traits.social_status: Family relationships affected by guilt; has a supportive circle of friends; negative thinking affecting social motivation and daily focus
static_traits.medical_history: No similar problem history; has not yet received psychotherapy or counseling; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude, clear expression, able to reflect and cooperate, calm tone

basic_info.main_problem: I feel responsible for my parents' arguments, believing I am a terrible daughter and the root of their conflicts.
basic_info.core_demands: A recent argument between her parents triggered intense guilt and a sense of responsibility; she hopes to gain support and guidance through counseling.
growth_experiences: The parents argued recently, and since then feelings of guilt and self-attribution have repeatedly appeared; the client believes their own behavior is the cause of the parental conflict, and thus tends more to avoid conflict and to please the parents in family interactions.
About a year ago, after a close friend got Engaged, I began comparing my progress in intimate relationships with friends, triggering worries and Self-doubt about 'whether I can find a partner'.

core_beliefs: It is all my fault (I should be responsible for others' conflicts)
I may never find a partner

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my parents argue, it must be because I did something wrong or did not fulfill my 'good child' responsibilities.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding conflicts, pleasing my parents more to ease guilt and Anxiety.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is because of me; I am a terrible daughter.

special_situations.event: Seeing happy couples or Attending social activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I still have no partner now or my habits differ from others, it means I will not be loved and the future will be bad too.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to socialize more and joins dating apps to change the current situation.

special_situations.event: A close friend got Engaged, triggering comparison
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my progress in intimate relationships is not like my peers', it means I am a failure and not worthy of being loved.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently makes social comparisons and tries to 'catch up' with peers through more socializing.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them; I have fallen behind.

special_situations.event: Being alone and playing video games for long periods
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am often Being alone and immersed in games, I will become unsociable and no one will like me.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Choosing to stay home playing games when anxious to temporarily ease discomfort.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My habits make people dislike me; I cannot find a partner.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to maintain family harmony, to be recognized and loved by parents, to become a 'good child'.
core_conflict.fear: Fearing parents' discord will be blamed on myself, being criticized or rejected; worrying that expressing my own needs will burden Mother.
defense_goal: Maintains relationships and a sense of safety by pleasing parents, avoiding conflict, and self-blame

object_relations.object_representation: Fragile parents who are easily affected and may be 'hurt' by me (especially Mother)

object_relations.self_representation: A Loneliness person not chosen in intimate relationships
object_relations.object_representation: Others/potential partners are a hard-to-approach, superior group different from myself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about discussing my guilt and worries with Mother, or worrying such a talk will burden Mother
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing expressing my feelings will hurt Mother or increase her stress, so I should stay Silent to protect her.
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing worries in a gentle, reserved tone, emphasizing 'I do not want to trouble others', avoiding directly stating my own needs, instead seeking third-party (counselor) support.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When parents argue or the atmosphere is tense
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributes conflict to herself; believes she must take responsibility and repair the situation.
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-blaming language (e.g. 'It is all my fault'), quickly apologizing or over-promising to please others, belittling myself to defuse the situation.

manifestations: Worrying I will never find a partner when Seeing happy couples or Attending social activities
Questioning whether my lifestyle leads to inability to build intimate relationships after Being alone and playing video games for long periods
Comparing progress in intimate relationships with friends, worsening worries about Loneliness
outcomes: Pessimistic Anticipation about future intimate relationships

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Believing 'I must/should please my parents and avoid any conflict'
Treats peers' progress in intimate relationships as a standard she must also reach

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Worrying that expressing guilt to Mother will 'burden her', so keeping feelings bottled up inside
Replacing the expression of dissatisfaction or seeking support with self-blame

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-criticism ('It is all my fault')
Excessively caring about what others might think, limiting outings and social attempts

exception_events.target_problem: When Seeing couples or Attending social activities, the client usually develops the thought 'I will never find a partner' and has reduced motivation for socializing.
exception_events.unique_outcome: At one Social gathering, had fun with friends and felt connected; negative Anticipation clearly weakened in the moment and mood was more relaxed.
exception_events.reason: Different situation/support: being with familiar friends, interested in the activity itself; different approach: participating in communication more proactively, so this time did not fall into past pessimistic Anticipation.

exception_events.target_problem: When Being alone, often getting addicted to video games and avoiding going out socially, further worsening the worry 'I cannot find a partner'.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In one chat using a dating app, having a pleasant and sustained conversation; even without follow-up, experiencing positive interaction and connection.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: proactively initiating and maintaining conversations on the dating app; different understanding: focusing on process quality rather than outcome, thus experiencing connection rather than failure.

positive_force: Close relationship with Mother, willing to seek professional support
Has a supportive circle of friends and has experienced positive social connections
Able to identify and describe automatic thoughts, willing to try alternative perspectives and behavioral experiments
negative_force: Marked tendency toward self-blame and guilt
Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, personalization, and jumping to conclusions appear frequently
Social comparison reinforcing inferiority and despair
Tending to avoid socializing when anxious and immersing in video games, forming a vicious cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive self-blame and strong guilt occur when the parents quarrel
antecedent: Parents arguing or a tense atmosphere at home
target_behavior.core_reason: Personalizing others' conflicts and introjecting them as one's own responsibility ('It is all my fault'), to maintain the recognized 'good child' image.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding outward expression and conflicts, trying to maintain family harmony and gain recognition through self-blame.
target_behavior.consequence: Worsening Anxiety and guilt, tenser family interactions, affecting daily focus and routines.

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and immersing in video games when Being alone
antecedent: Being alone, developing negative Anticipation after seeing couples or social scenes
Increased self-doubt about one's own habits
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and overgeneralization leading to pessimistic Anticipation about social and intimate relationships, to avoid possible failure or Being rejected.
target_behavior.function: Briefly easing Anxiety and discomfort, gaining immediate self-comfort (through games), while avoiding potential social pressure.
target_behavior.consequence: Fewer social opportunities, negative beliefs reinforced, worsened Loneliness and inferiority.
